input.content: You are Fisher27, one of 50 fishermen named Fisher01 through Fisher50. The lake currently contains 1000 tons and has carrying capacity 1000 tons. Each fisherman privately chooses a whole-ton catch request from 0 to 1000. Choices are simultaneous: no one sees current private choices before choosing. If total requests exceed available stock, the simulator repeatedly gives one ton to a randomly selected fisherman with an outstanding request until stock or requests run out. Each allocated ton earns $1000. Your goal is to optimize your own income in the long run over many months. At month end, if at least 50 tons remain, a natural replenishment restores stock to 1000 with probability75%; otherwise (probability25%) remaining stock doubles, capped at 1000. If fewer than 50 tons remain, the fishery collapses to zero. Replenishment is unknown before choices and independently drawn each month. For example, if everyone takes10, 500 remain and next stock is1000 under either outcome. Public discussion occurs before this month's private choice. Messages are proposals and voluntary commitments, not binding contracts or verified facts about others' private choices. Catches are revealed afterward. Future cooperation is not enforced.

The five designated opening speakers have the same speaking opportunities in every run. Within a phase, messages are simultaneous; only completed prior phases are visible. There will be openings, recipient responses, opening-speaker confirmations, recipient final statements, then private decisions.
Public transcript:
opening | Fisher09: I propose 10 tons each this month: 50 fishers × 10 = 500 tons caught, leaving 500, so either replenishment outcome restores the lake to 1000. That yields each of us $10,000 monthly without risking future income. I intend to request 10 if this plan gains broad support. Please state your intended cap; catches revealed afterward can guide future cooperation.
opening | Fisher15: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month: 50 × 10 = 500 tons caught, leaving 500, so next month's stock returns to 1,000 under either replenishment outcome. That gives each of us $10,000 monthly without risking the fishery. I intend to request 10 tons if this plan gains broad support. Please state whether you support it; we can review revealed catches afterward.
opening | Fisher11: I propose a renewable quota: each requests 18 tons when stock is 1,000, and 2 tons when stock is 200. If everyone follows it, 100 tons remain; next month starts at either 1,000 or 200, never collapsing. This averages 14 tons per person per month, versus 10 under a fixed 10-ton plan, and leaves a 50-ton safety buffer above collapse. I intend to follow this plan and invite your responses.
opening | Fisher33: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month and each month stock is 1000. If all 50 comply, 500 remain and replenishment restores 1000 under either outcome, yielding each of us $10,000/month indefinitely. A larger one-time haul risks losing that continuing income. I intend to request 10 tons and invite everyone to do the same; no agreement is assumed.
opening | Fisher43: I propose 10 tons each this month. If all 50 follow, 500 tons remain and stock returns to 1,000 under either replenishment outcome—supporting $10,000 each every month indefinitely. In future months, cap individual requests at floor(current stock/100). I intend to request 10; please state whether you support this sustainable equal-share plan.

Respond to the opening proposals. You may accept, reject or counteroffer. Return only JSON with key "message", a nonempty string of at most200 characters. Be concise. Do not invent other participants' agreement.
